apiErisimi.aciklama: Connect your own software, automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n) and AI assistants like Claude to your account. Keys can only do what you allow and can be revoked at any time.
apiErisimi.aciklamaYonetici: The agency's API keys and webhook endpoints; you can also see and revoke your clients' keys.
apiErisimi.ajansUyari: An agency key can access the records of ALL clients. Select only the scopes you need, set an expiry date (recommended: {{gun}} days), add an IP allowlist if you can and keep the key in a password manager.
apiErisimi.kopyalanamadi: Could not copy — select the text and copy it manually

kapsam.destek_yaz: Open and reply to support tickets
kapsam.qr_oku: Read QR codes and scan counts

olay.destek_yanitlandi: Reply added to a support ticket
olay.asistan_devredildi: AI assistant handed a visitor over to a human

anahtar.kapsamAciklama: The key can only perform the actions you select; don't pick scopes you don't need.
anahtar.sonKullanmaAciklama: If left empty, the key stays valid until it is revoked.
anahtar.suresizOnay: I understand the risk of a non-expiring agency key (not recommended)
anahtar.ipAciklama: IP addresses or CIDR ranges, comma- or line-separated. If empty, the key works from any address.
anahtar.birKez: The key “{{ad}}” is shown only now. Copy it and store it somewhere safe; once you close this box it can never be displayed again.
anahtar.iptalOnay: Revoke the key “{{ad}}”? Requests made with it are rejected immediately; this cannot be undone.

webhook.yenidenDenemeBilgisi: A failed delivery is retried up to {{sayi}} times with growing intervals over 3 days; after {{esik}} consecutive failed attempts the endpoint is disabled automatically and you are notified.
webhook.pasifSebebi: Disabled automatically after consecutive failed deliveries. Fix your receiver and enable it again.
webhook.gecis: The old secret is also signing until {{tarih}}
webhook.gizliYenileOnay: Generate a new signing secret? The old secret stays valid as a second signature for 24 hours; update your receiver within that time.
webhook.silOnay: Permanently delete the endpoint {{url}} and its delivery history?
webhook.gizliBirKez: The signing secret is shown only now. Store it safely to verify the MK-Webhook-Imza header on your receiver.
webhook.urlAciklama: https only. Internal network, localhost and cloud metadata addresses are rejected; redirects are not followed.
webhook.tumMusterilerAciklama: When off, only the agency's own events (such as CRM leads) are sent.

belgeler.giris: The REST API speaks JSON; every endpoint requires a scope and only returns records the key can access.
belgeler.kimlikAciklama: Authorization: Bearer mk_live_… or the X-API-Key header. Panel sessions are not accepted by this API.
belgeler.sayfalamaAciklama: limit (1–100) and cursor; the response is {veri, sonraki_cursor, daha_var}. Use updated_since to fetch only changed records.
belgeler.hatalarAciklama: {"hata": {"kod", "mesaj"}} — branch on the code. Another account's record returns 404, a missing scope 403.
belgeler.idempotencyAciklama: Send an Idempotency-Key header on write endpoints: a retry with the same key within 24 hours gets the same response and nothing is created twice.
belgeler.hizAciklama: Per-key limit per minute; when exceeded you get 429 with a Retry-After header.
belgeler.webhookAciklama: Events are POSTed as JSON to the URL you choose. Verify the signature over the raw body, reject timestamps older than 5 minutes and answer with 2xx within 10 seconds. After a secret rotation the header carries two v1= signatures for 24 hours; one matching is enough. The same event may arrive again: deduplicate with MK-Webhook-Id.

uc.get_hesap: The key's account, scopes and record counts.
uc.get_gorevler: Lists tasks (filter by proje_id and durum).
uc.post_gorevler: Adds a task to a project.
uc.get_destek_talep_id: A single ticket with its thread.
uc.post_crm_adaylar: Adds a lead to the CRM (agency only).
uc.get_qr: Lists QR codes and scan counts.
uc.get_menuler_magaza_id_siparisler: A store's orders (without the customer's name and address).

mcp.aciklama: With the Model Context Protocol server, Claude can read your projects, tasks, invoices and support tickets and — if you allow it — create tasks and tickets. The connection uses the same API key.
mcp.anahtarNotu: Replace mk_live_… with an API key you created on this tab. Claude only sees the tools within the key's scopes; without a write scope, write tools do not appear at all.
mcp.codeAciklama: Add it with a single command in the terminal, or put it in your project's .mcp.json file (keep the key in an environment variable).
mcp.desktopAciklama: Add it to claude_desktop_config.json (Settings › Developer › Edit config) and restart Claude (requires Node.js).
mcp.araclarAciklama: Each tool requires a scope; tools without a matching scope are not listed.
